Trailer released for 'Lust Stories 3' anthology film

The trailer for the upcoming Netflix anthology film 'Lust Stories 3' has been released. The film features an ensemble cast including Aditi Rao Hydari, Siddharth, Radhika Apte, Konkona Sen Sharma, Radhika Madan, Sana Thampi, Vijay Varma, Abhishek Banerjee, Ali Fazal, and Gurfateh Pirzada. The anthology is directed by Kiran Rao, Vishal Bhardwaj, Shakun Batra, and Vikramaditya Motwane. Vishal Bhardwaj has spoken about the film's themes of love, desire, and complex narratives.
